messages:
Priya K: Ping — CloudWave is blocked on the SI handoff. During validation their infra team sees 502s from the gateway after we enable the privatePeering path. Can someone from eng-arch take a look?

Liam R: I can jump in. Quick question: is this happening on Dedicated or Private?

Priya K: Private (customer VPC). They followed the marketplace image and the ConvergeSI manifest. Failure appears after routing flips to v2 gateway.

Marco G: Seen similar when the envoy sidecar fails TLS handshake to our edge-gw. Can you paste a truncated log from the host?

Priya K: Pasted logs from their engineer: ```ERROR 2026-03-15T09:14:02Z envoy tls handshake failed: unknown_ca```

Jin T: That points to cert chain mismatch. CloudWave is terminating TLS at their NLB and we expect mTLS between customer edge and our private endpoint. Did they upload the signed cert bundle?

Priya K: They uploaded something called cert_bundle_v1.zip. I asked them to confirm CN/SANs but waiting.

Liam R: If certs are wrong we should fallback to the canary route (no-mtls) temporarily so service stays up. @deploy-bot can you re-route traffic to fallback-policy:canary-route for customer cw-310?

deploy-bot: Re-route job queued by Liam R. Running policy check...

deploy-bot: Re-route applied to cw-310 -> fallback-policy:canary-route (canary=20%) at 2026-03-15T09:18:11Z. Monitor for errors.

Marco G: Good call. Meanwhile @Priya K ask the SI to dump the edge-gw cert config: `openssl x509 -in /etc/edge/cert.pem -text -noout` and confirm issuer + chain. If issuer != Redwood CA we need them to present the full chain.

Priya K: Sending instructions now. Also flagging this as an implementation escalation to ConvergeSI — they own the manifest generator, might be producing a bundle missing intermediates.

Jin T: Can we get a short architecture review before we change more? I'll set a 30-min sync with CloudWave ops + ConvergeSI + eng-arch in 20 minutes. Agenda: cert chain, routing policy, and runbook gap.

Liam R: Please add a runbook action to verify `tcp:443` session to our private endpoint from a customer pod: `curl -vk https://private.redwood-inference.internal/status` — we should assert TLS details there.

Priya K: Added. Also creating an action item: ConvergeSI to produce signed bundle with full chain and manifest patch to include `ca_bundle: full_chain`.

Marco G: If they can't produce a chain quickly, ops + SI should coordinate to temporarily white-list CloudWave and increase observability (tcpdump + envoy access logs) so we can triage without customer impact.

Priya K: Noted. I'll keep this thread updated after the sync. Thanks all. :pray:

Liam R: Thanks — will hang in the call. :thumbsup:

Jin T: Post-call: we should add a small doc to the marketplace onboarding checklist about cert chain verification. I'll draft it.

Priya K: Perfect — that's a good postmortem item.
